description: Take ownership of a lane so the board shows who is on it. Refuses a lane another seat already holds unless shared is true, which is the opt-in for genuine pair work - say so in the Boardroom first. A claim goes stale after 48 hours and the lane becomes takeable again. lane accepts the printed ref (AP-01) or the lane id (boardroom).

lane.description: Ref from the board's first column (AP-01) or lane id (boardroom).

shared.description: Join a lane someone else holds. Only after saying so in the Boardroom.
